power.neoorigins.feline_mobs_ignore.desc: E wehi ana ngā Creepers i a koe, ā, e kore e whakatata atu.
power.neoorigins.feline_water_weakness.n: E kino ana ki te wai
power.neoorigins.feline_water_weakness.d: E 0.5 ngā whiu ia hēkona i te wai, i te ua rānei  he kino te huruhuru maroke.
power.neoorigins.feline_hunger_drain.des: He 30% te tere ake o te pūngao i te tangata.
origins.neoorigins.golem.name: Ko te Golem
origins.neoorigins.golem.description: He pārae haere o te rino me te hiahia  tata kore e nekehia, engari he puhoi, he ngoikore hoki ki te wera.
power.neoorigins.golem_natural_armor.des: Permanent Resistance I  Iron plating shrugs off blows even while unequipped.
E 80 ōrau te kaha o te whakaheke.
power.neoorigins.golem_size.name: He anga whakarewa
power.neoorigins.golem_size.description: He 30% te rahi ake i tētahi kaitākaro noa.
power.neoorigins.golem_effect_immunity.d: He ārai ki te waikura, ki te mate, ki te hiakai.
power.neoorigins.golem_slow_movement.des: He 25% te puhoi ake o te nekehanga i te tangata noa.
power.neoorigins.golem_fire_weakness.des: Ka 80% ake te kino mai i te ahi, te awa, me te whakapā o te poraka magma  ka kawea e te rino te wera.
origins.neoorigins.caveborn.name: Caveborn (Tuhinga o mua)
origins.neoorigins.caveborn.description: I whakaarahia i roto i te pōuri hohonu  kai kohatu raw, chews i roto i ore ki ringa tahanga, engari maroke i roto i te ra.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_night_vision.d: Ko ngā kanohi e hāngai ana ki te pōuri hohonu  kāore e hiahiatia he rama. Whakapā atu ki te paatene Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.caveborn_no_fall_damage: E mōhio ana ia ki te tau ki runga i te whenua kōaro. Kāore he kino o te hinganga.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_mining_speed.n: Ko ngā Ringa o te Kairimi
power.neoorigins.caveborn_mining_speed.d: Ka wahia ngā poraka katoa kia rua ngā tere  ka tukua te kohatu ki ngā ringa mōhiotia.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_stone_fists.de: Ko ōku ringaringa tahanga, he pākaha kohatu  whati i ngā kōhao me ngā kohatu me te kore taputapu.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_mining_fortune: I te wā e kaha ana te waimarie (ka whakawhiwhia e te kai taimana), ka taka iho nga poraka parahi me te mea kua kerihia me te Fortune II.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_stone.name: Te Kai Kohatu
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_stone.desc: Ka taea e ia te kai i te kohatu kohatu, kohatu, kōhatu, diorite, andesite, tuff, deep slate, cobbled deep slate, basalt, me te kohatu pango mo te kai iti. E kore e haere ki raro i runga i te kopu ki tonu.
power.neoorigins.nether_fungus_diet.name: Te Whakanui i ngā Pōkai
power.neoorigins.nether_fungus_diet.desc: He kai tika ngā ngārara kōaro me ngā ngārara whero i roto i te Nether  pāwhiri matau ki te kai mō te 5 te hiakai me te 0.6 te makuku. E kore e haere ki raro i runga i te kopu ki tonu.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_copper.des: Ka taea te kai i te parahi parahi, parahi raw, parahi parahi, parahi parahi hohonu, me nga poraka parahi raw  he kai ngawari i waenga i te kohatu me te rino. E kore e haere ki raro i runga i te kopu ki tonu.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_iron.name: Te Ngakau Maitai
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_iron.descr: Ka taea e ia te kai i ngā konganuku rino, i te rino raw, i ngā konganuku rino, i te parahi rino, i te parahi rino hohonu, i ngā poraka rino raw  he kai tika mō te kaituku. E kore e haere ki raro i runga i te kopu ki tonu.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_gold.name: Te Kōhanga Reo Whakanui
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_gold.descr: Ka taea e ia te kai i te koura, i te koura raw, i te koura nuggets, i te koura ore, i te koura ore deepplate, i te koura ore raro, me nga poraka koura raw  he kai taonga ake. E kore e haere ki raro i runga i te kopu ki tonu.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_diamond.de: Ka taea e ia te kai taimana, kohatu taimana, me te kohatu taimana hohonu  ka taea te whakataurite ki te karaka koura i roto i te makona. E kore e haere ki raro i runga i te kopu ki tonu.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_emerald.de: Ka taea e ia te kai i ngā miraka, i te parahi miraka, i te parahi miraka hohonu  te kai nui rawa atu i te netherite. E kore e haere ki raro i runga i te kopu ki tonu.
Ka taea e ia te kai i ngā rākau netherite, ngā kirihou, me ngā toenga tawhito  te kai tino nui rawa o te ao. E kore e haere ki raro i runga i te kopu ki tonu.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_copper_bonus.d: Mā te kai parahi e whakawhiwhia ai te Waipū Wai I mō te 60 hēkona.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_iron_bonus.des: Ko te kai i te rino e tuku ana i te Haste I mō te 60 hēkona.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_gold_bonus.des: Ko te kai i te koura e tuku ana i te Tere I mō ngā meneti e rua.
Ko te kai i te taimana e tuku ana i te Luck II mō te 5 meneti  ka āhei te Mining Fortune i te mea e kaha ana.
Ko te kai i te emerala ka whakawhiwhia ki te Whakaaetanga ahi mo te 5 meneti  Kei te mura tonu koe i te ra, engari kaore e taea e ia te tahu i a koe.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_netherite_bonu: Ko te kai i te netherite e tuku ana i te kaha I me te ātete I mō te 5 meneti.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_daylight_damag: Ka mura te ahi, ka kotahi te kino i ia hēkona i te wā e pā ana ki te ra tika.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_small_frame.de: 85% te rahi o tētahi kaitākaro noa  he māmā ngā rori iti.
origins.neoorigins.sylvan.name: Ko Sylvan
origins.neoorigins.sylvan.description: He wairua nō te ngahere tawhito  tere i waenganui i ngā rākau, e arohaina ana e te kararehe mohoao, ā, e kaha ana ki te hopu i ngā hoariri ki te ngaru o ngā pakiaka. Kua whakaorangia e te ua, engari kua tahuna e te Nether.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_mobs_ignore.name: Kotahi ki te Taiao
power.neoorigins.sylvan_mobs_ignore.desc: Ka waiho koe e ngā tinihanga hoariri i te rangimarie  ka utua e rātau mēnā ka patu koe i te tuatahi.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_regen_in_water.n: Ko te Awhi o te Ua
power.neoorigins.sylvan_regen_in_water.d: He puhoi te whakaora i te wā e pā ana ki te wai.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_forest_speed.des: Ka piki ake te tere i a ia e noho ana i roto i ngā koiora ngahere.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_nether_damage.na: Ko te Raru o te Pirihimana
power.neoorigins.sylvan_nether_damage.de: Ka kotahi te whiu ia hēkona i te wā e noho ana i roto i ngā koiora o raro. Ka ārai rawa ngā hu o Frost Walker i te kino.
origins.neoorigins.draconic.name: Ko te Draconic
origins.neoorigins.draconic.description: Dragon-rangi me te wehi  ārai ki te ahi, me te whakamataku ki te kararehe, engari tahuna te mura draconic i roto i te manawanui tere.
He ārai ki te ahi, ki te awa, ki te magma, ki te mura  ka wera te toto tarakona.
He māmā ake te kaukau i roto i te awa, i ētahi atu e kaukau ana i roto i te wai.
power.neoorigins.draconic_lava_vision.de: E kite mārama ana mā roto i te awa, kāore he pōhaku, he pōhēhē e mura ana  kāore he mea e huna i ngā hohonu rewa.
power.neoorigins.draconic_slow_fall.name: Ko te Pouaka Rakau
power.neoorigins.draconic_slow_fall.desc: Ka pakaru ngā parirau i tō hinganga  kāore he kino o te hinganga.
power.neoorigins.draconic_scare_mobs.des: Ko te nuinga o ngā mea ora kore  kararehe, tangata kāinga, kararehe mohoao  rere i to koutou aroaro draconic.
power.neoorigins.draconic_size.name: He Rangatiratanga Nui
power.neoorigins.draconic_size.descripti: 20% nui ake i te kaitākaro noa  uaua ki te ngaro.
power.neoorigins.draconic_attack_bonus.d: Ka whakawhiwhia e ia whiu e rua ngā whiu atu.
power.neoorigins.draconic_water_weakness: E 1.5 ngā whiu ia hēkona i te wai, i te ua rānei  me manawa te ahi.
power.neoorigins.draconic_hunger_drain.n: Te Aroha Nui ki te Kai
power.neoorigins.draconic_hunger_drain.d: Ka mura ake te 50% o te pūngao  ka wera te mura.
origins.neoorigins.revenant.name: Ko te Revenant
origins.neoorigins.revenant.description: Kāore e taea e tētahi tangata e haereere ana i roto i te matū, e pupuhi ana i te poke o te poke  te ruku, e kite ana hoki i te pōuri, engari ka āta ora, ka tahuna i te rā.
power.neoorigins.revenant_entity_group.d: Kua whakarārangitia hei undead. Kua whara i te Hauora Inamata, kua ora i te Pakaru Inamata, e ārai ana i te Wairua.
power.neoorigins.revenant_water_breathin: Kāore e hiahiatia e ia te manawa. Ka taea te ora i raro i te wai.
power.neoorigins.revenant_night_vision.n: Ngā Mata o te Tangata Mate
power.neoorigins.revenant_night_vision.d: Ka āhei te kite mārama i te pōuri katoa. Whakapā atu ki te paatene Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.revenant_daylight_damag: Ko te kanga o te rā
Ka mura te ahi, ka rua ngā kino i ia hēkona i te wā e pā ana ki te rā tika.
power.neoorigins.revenant_slow_regen.des: Ko te whakahoutanga o te hauora māori ka heke ki te 40% o te tikanga.
origins.neoorigins.tiny.name: He iti rawa
origins.neoorigins.tiny.description: He iti te rahi, engari he tere, he māmā hoki  ka eke ki nga mea katoa, ka hopu i nga taonga, engari ka patu ano he huruhuru.
power.neoorigins.tiny_size.name: He iti iho
power.neoorigins.tiny_size.description: 50% te rahi o tētahi kaitākaro noa.
power.neoorigins.tiny_wall_climbing.name: Te pupuri o te mata
power.neoorigins.tiny_wall_climbing.desc: Ka taea e ia te piki i tētahi pakitara me te ngāwari.
power.neoorigins.tiny_speed_boost.name: Ko te Scurry
power.neoorigins.tiny_speed_boost.descri: Ka tere ake te 20% i te tangata noa.
power.neoorigins.tiny_no_fall_damage.nam: He Maamaa Rite ki te Pua
power.neoorigins.tiny_no_fall_damage.des: He mea iti rawa kia kore ai e whai pānga te hinga. Kāore he kino o te hinganga.
power.neoorigins.tiny_item_magnetism.des: Ka kukume ngā ahanoa mai i te tawhiti.
power.neoorigins.tiny_attack_penalty.des: E whakaiti ana i te pānga e rua i ia whiu.
power.neoorigins.tiny_hunger_drain.name: Te Ngakau Iti
power.neoorigins.tiny_hunger_drain.descr: Ka 80 ōrau tere ake te hiakai  ka hohoro te tahu kai e ngā tinana iti.
origins.neoorigins.cave_dragon.name: Ngārara o te ana
origins.neoorigins.cave_dragon.descripti: He tarakona ahi me te kohatu, i whanau i raro iho i te ao. E tipu ana i roto i te wera me te pōuri, ā, ka tupu ki tōna kaha katoa i te wā.
power.neoorigins.cave_dragon_form.name: Te āhua o te rākau o te ana
power.neoorigins.cave_dragon_form.descri: Tangohia te āhua o tētahi tarakona anawā  he mea hanga i te magma me te atarangi. Ko ō āhuatanga tarakona, te tipu, me ngā āheinga e whakahaeretia ana e te Dragon Survival.
origins.neoorigins.forest_dragon.name: Te Rākau Ngahere
origins.neoorigins.forest_dragon.descrip: He tarakona o te pakiaka me te tataramoa, i te kāinga i waenganui i nga rakau onamata. He manawanui, he kaha hoki, ka kaha ake i a ia e pakeke ana.
power.neoorigins.forest_dragon_form.name: Te āhua o te Rākau Ngahere
power.neoorigins.forest_dragon_form.desc: Tangohia te āhua o te tarakona ngahere  he mea hanga o te waina me te waipiro. Ko ō āhuatanga tarakona, te tipu, me ngā āheinga e whakahaeretia ana e te Dragon Survival.
origins.neoorigins.sea_dragon.name: Ngārara o te Moana
origins.neoorigins.sea_dragon.descriptio: He tarakona o te ngaru me te tupuhi, i whānau mai i te wai tuwhera. He tere i raro i ngā ngaru, ka tino kaha ake i te pakeke.
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_form.name: Te āhua o te Dragon o te Moana
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_form.descrip: Tangohia te āhua o te tarakona moana  he mea hanga o te rere me te uira. Ko ō āhuatanga tarakona, te tipu, me ngā āheinga e whakahaeretia ana e te Dragon Survival.
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_apex_hp.name: Ko te Riwaiata
